mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cfg_version( version_id, object_type, object_id, version_no, spec, content_hash, status, publish_note, published_by, published_at, previous_version_id) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{versionNo}, #{spec}::jsonb, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{publishNote}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt}, #{previousVersionId})
mapper.select: SELECT version_id AS versionId, object_type AS objectType, object_id AS objectId, version_no AS versionNo, spec::text AS spec, content_hash AS contentHash, status, publish_note AS publishNote, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt, previous_version_id AS previousVersionId FROM cfg_version WHERE object_type = #{objectType} AND object_id = #{objectId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

SELECT version_id AS versionId, object_type AS objectType, object_id AS objectId, version_no AS versionNo, spec::text AS spec, content_hash AS contentHash, status, publish_note AS publishNote, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt, previous_version_id AS previousVersionId FROM cfg_version WHERE version_id = #{versionId}
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM cfg_version WHERE object_type = #{objectType} AND object_id = #{objectId}
